persona.name: 陈伟 (Chen Wei)
persona.summary: Chen Wei is CTO of ZhiLian Tech, a 200-person SaaS company in Shanghai providing supply-chain analytics to manufacturers. Company knowledge lives in DingTalk, Feishu (Lark), email, Jira, Confluence, and a custom CRM — predominantly Chinese with English engineering threads.
persona.situation: A billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres is planned next sprint, led by Priya. Meanwhile the Shanghai warehouse reports an inventory discrepancy on SKU-8842, and the team needs to decide whether a read replica is needed before the cutover.

scopes.label: db-migration
scopes.business_meaning: The billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres: planning, risk, and cutover timeline.

scopes.label: inventory-discrepancy
scopes.business_meaning: Shanghai warehouse inventory discrepancy on SKU-8842: short by 120 units, investigating scan error.

scopes.label: infra-architecture
scopes.business_meaning: Infrastructure architecture decisions: read replicas, downtime mitigation, and monitoring.

messages.body: 决定: 将计费数据库从 MySQL 迁移到 Postgres，定于下个迭代执行，负责人为 Priya，主要风险是切换期间的停机。
Priya 确认 Postgres 迁移计划: 第一步导出 MySQL 数据，第二步在维护窗口执行 cutover，第三步验证数据完整性。预计停机时间 2 小时。
Engineering note (English): 'The MySQL to Postgres migration is straightforward but we need to test the cutover script in staging first. Priya suggests a dry run this Thursday.'
上海仓库报告库存差异: SKU-8842 实际数量比系统记录少 120 件，正在调查是否为扫描错误。仓库主管王明已确认物理盘点无误。
扫描错误排查: 手持终端 PDA-200 的条码扫描模块固件版本过旧，可能导致重复扫描漏读。已升级固件并重新盘点 SKU-8842。
架构决策: Postgres 切换前需要先建立只读副本 (read replica) 以避免报表停机。副本部署在从库，通过流复制同步，延迟预计 < 1 秒。
Ticket INFRA-4521: Provision Postgres read replica in staging. Assignee: Priya. Status: In Progress. ETA: Friday.

recall_tests.intent: Find the database migration plan and owner.

synthesis.business_question: What is the database migration plan, who owns it, and what is the risk?

forget.rationale: The inventory discrepancy has been resolved after firmware update and recount; the records can be purged.
